gloss: just a moment ago; only a short while ago

definitions.gloss: just a moment ago; only a short while ago
definitions.explanation: Refers to a point in time only minutes before the present. つい emphasizes that very little time has passed; {先|さき}ほど is a polite word for 'a little while ago.'

examples.japanese: つい{先|さき}ほど⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧きた。
examples.english: I got back just a moment ago.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{件|けん}→件：11720_ken⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧つい{先|さき}ほど⟦{連絡|れんらく}→連絡：01524_renraku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
examples.english: I was informed of that matter just a short while ago.

examples.japanese: つい{先|さき}ほど⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧にいた⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}えない→見える：01165_mieru⟧。
examples.english: He was here just a moment ago, yet he is already nowhere to be seen.

notes:
Combines つい ('just; barely') with {先|さき}ほど ('a little while ago') to stress that the event happened only minutes before now. More polite and slightly more formal than ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧.

POSITION IN SENTENCE:
Appears before the verb or at the start of the sentence.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦さっき→さっき：01264_sakki⟧: a little while ago — casual, everyday speech
- {先|さき}ほど: a little while ago — polite and neutral; つい adds the 'only just' nuance
- ⟦たった{今|いま}→たった今：20560_tattaima⟧: just now — even more immediate, 'this very moment'
